fields.statement: Verified at 7de305eb (attempt 2, after compliance finding f1). go test -trimpath -short ./internal/api -run 'Review|Gate|RunReview' -v: all 17 tests PASS, including TestReviewQuestionHandleFullID (two IDs sharing their first 8 chars get different handles carrying the full lower-cased ID) and TestReviewAskedFor, which now calls gateReview with a round-3 run whose journalled asked entry is review-<id>-r3-f1-2. The gate takes it as the question left, and it rejects another run's handle. (The package exit was FAIL only from the root-state guard: the root daemon changed ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json during the run. The full package hit a 10m timeout only because TestInboxGateQuestionsBudget blocked on the shared budgetLock under load 17.) Mutation check in a scratch copy: reverting gateReview to the old asked[reviewQuestionHandle(...)] lookup makes TestReviewAskedFor fail with 'confirmed finding f1 with no question left for it', so f1 is fixed. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-review-check.*|run-gate.*)$': ok. That covers run-review-check-handles: two runs started in the same second share an 8-char ID prefix; run 1's full-ID handle is taken by an unrelated question; review-check gives run 1 review-<id>-r3-f1-2, journals it in the asked entry, and gives run 2 its own base handle; a second review-check returns added=false with one asked entry. Diff read: reviewQuestionHandle uses the full ID; review-check finds journalled entries via reviewAskedFor, otherwise uniqueHandle; gateReview uses reviewAskedFor. Remaining nit f2 (a stale comment naming reviewQuestionHandleFor, and gateReview's asked map is now unused) does not affect acceptance.
